repos.name: finic-ai/kairos
repos.description: Real time event intelligence, fraud and risk decisioning for financial behavior.
repos.one_liner: A real-time event intelligence platform designed for financial fraud detection and risk decisioning.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for high-performance event processing and integration.
Focuses on behavioral analysis to identify anomalies in financial transactions.
Provides a decisioning engine for automated risk mitigation and fraud prevention.
Ideal for fintech developers building secure, real-time payment or trading infrastructure.

repos.name: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
repos.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
repos.one_liner: A Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers to improve LLM accuracy and explainability.
bullets: Utilizes graph-based structures to ground LLM outputs in deterministic logic.
Enhances context retrieval by mapping unstructured data to semantic ontologies.
Reduces hallucinations in AI agents by enforcing structured reasoning paths.
Targeted at enterprise AI applications requiring high reliability and auditability.

repos.name: Goncafer47/Stablecoin-Payment-Gateway
repos.description: Self-hosted, non-custodial stablecoin payment gateway with x402 and invoice checkout. Accepts USDC, USDT, PYUSD and DAI across 8 networks with QR payments, payment links, settlement tracking and signed webhooks. REST API, micropayments, exports, zero platform fees and no KYC. Python, cross-platform.
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted, non-custodial payment gateway for stablecoins supporting multiple networks and invoice generation.
bullets: Python-based backend supporting USDC, USDT, PYUSD, and DAI across 8 blockchain networks.
Features non-custodial architecture, ensuring users maintain control of private keys.
Includes payment link generation, QR code support, and automated settlement tracking.
Essential infrastructure for DeFi projects or merchants accepting crypto payments.

repos.name: tddworks/SkillsManager
repos.description: A macOS application for discovering, browsing, and installing skills for AI coding assistants. Manage skills for Claude Code and Codex from GitHub repositories or your local filesystem.
repos.one_liner: A macOS application for managing and deploying skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code.
bullets: Swift-based native macOS application for local skill management.
Allows discovery and installation of AI agent capabilities from GitHub or local files.
Streamlines the workflow for developers customizing agentic coding environments.
Enables modular extension of AI coding assistants to handle specific project tasks.
